title: MoE-SpeQ: Speculative Quantized Decoding with Proactive Expert Prefetching and Offloading for Mixture-of-Experts
authors: Wenfeng Wang; Jiacheng Liu; Xiaofeng Hou; Xinfeng Xia; Peng Tang; Mingxuan Zhang; Chao Li; Minyi Guo
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

problem_statement.en: On memory-constrained accelerators, offloaded MoE inference is dominated by PCIe transfers of expert weights (e.g. 98.9% of step time on Mixtral-8x7B over an A100-40G), and token-level expert routing is highly entropic (close to theoretical maximum on Qwen-1.5MoE), so reactive caching policies such as LRU and one-layer-ahead predictors are inadequate to hide the I/O latency.
problem_statement.zh: 在記憶體受限的加速器上，offloaded MoE 推理的整體時間主要被 expert 權重的 PCIe 傳輸佔據（例如在 A100-40G 上執行 Mixtral-8x7B 時佔 98.9% 的 step time），且 token 層級的 expert routing 高度發散（Qwen-1.5MoE 接近理論最大熵），使得 LRU 與單層 lookahead 預測等被動式 caching 策略無法有效隱藏 I/O 延遲。

key_innovation.en: MoE-SpeQ co-designs speculative execution with proactive expert offloading: a 4-bit INT4 GPTQ-quantized draft model that achieves 90.9% top-4 expert prediction fidelity (44.1% hard matches + 46.8% soft matches) acts as a high-fidelity multi-step lookahead. Three components consume this lookahead: (1) an Expert Scheduler with an Expert Lookahead Buffer (ELB) for hierarchical, layer-aware proactive prefetching; (2) a Speculative Governor that solves an Amortization Roofline Model online for the optimal draft length k* under TTFT SLO constraints; (3) an Execution Engine with a fused INT4 MoE CUDA kernel, computation reordering, and shared non-expert parameter and KV cache between draft and target.
key_innovation.zh: MoE-SpeQ 將 speculative execution 與主動式 expert offloading 共同設計：以 GPTQ 4-bit INT4 量化的 draft model 作為高保真多步 lookahead（top-4 expert 預測正確率 90.9%，其中 hard match 44.1%、soft match 46.8%）。三個組件消費此 lookahead：(1) 配備 Expert Lookahead Buffer（ELB）的 Expert Scheduler，執行階層式、layer-aware 的主動 prefetching；(2) Speculative Governor，於線上求解 Amortization Roofline Model，在 TTFT SLO 限制下決定最適 draft length k*；(3) Execution Engine，採用 fused INT4 MoE CUDA kernel、computation reordering，並讓 draft 與 target 共享 non-expert 參數與 KV cache。

baselines_compared: HuggingFace Transformers (device_map offloading), Mixtral-Offloading-SC (same cache), Mixtral-Offloading-SM (same memory)

key_improvements.en: At most 2.34x end-to-end throughput speedup on Phi-MoE over state-of-the-art offloading frameworks across five datasets (GSM8K, WikiText-2, HumanEval, GPQA, C4) and varying GPU memory budgets; INT4 draft model achieves 90.9% top-4 expert prediction accuracy on Qwen-MoE, surpassing a specialized one-layer-ahead predictor at 84.7%; fused INT4 MoE kernel outperforms PyTorch FP16, ExLlamaV1, ExLlamaV2, and Marlin in both prefill and decode latency for the evaluated MoE models.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Phi-MoE 上跨 GSM8K、WikiText-2、HumanEval、GPQA、C4 五項資料集及不同 GPU 記憶體預算下，端到端吞吐相較 state-of-the-art offloading 框架提升最多 2.34x；INT4 draft model 在 Qwen-MoE 上達到 90.9% 的 top-4 expert 預測準確率，優於專門的單層 lookahead 預測器（84.7%）；fused INT4 MoE kernel 在所評估的 MoE 模型上於 prefill 與 decode 延遲皆優於 PyTorch FP16、ExLlamaV1、ExLlamaV2 與 Marlin。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-40GB (PCIe 4.0 x16), Intel Xeon Silver 4310, DDR4 256 GB
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system-level prediction accuracy: 90.9% top-4 expert match)
models_validated: Phi-3.5-MoE (41.9B total / 6.6B activated), Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B (14.3B / 2.7B), DeepSeek-V2-Lite (15.7B / 2.4B), Mixtral-8x7B, Qwen-1.5MoE (analysis)

scope_assumptions.en: Single A100 (40 GB) workstation with PCIe 4.0 x16 (16 GB/s per direction); MLP linear layers quantized to symmetric INT4 with group size 128 while attention, norms, gating networks, and shared experts remain FP16; T_draft modeled as a linear function of k, T_pcie_init and T_verify as profiled constants/interpolations, only T_pcie_new(k) estimated online; Amortization Roofline Model assumes a single I/O roof slope set by PCIe bandwidth and ignores cross-request batching effects; comparison restricted to Transformers-based offloading frameworks (Mixtral-Offloading variants) for fairness, excluding vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單張 A100（40 GB）工作站，PCIe 4.0 x16（單向 16 GB/s）；MLP 線性層採對稱 INT4、group size 128 量化，attention、norm、gating network 與 shared expert 保留 FP16；T_draft 以 k 的線性函式建模，T_pcie_init 與 T_verify 為離線 profile 之常數或內插，僅 T_pcie_new(k) 於線上估算；Amortization Roofline Model 假設單一由 PCIe 頻寬決定的 I/O roof slope，並忽略跨 request 的 batching 效應；為公平比較，僅與基於 Transformers 的 offloading 框架（Mixtral-Offloading 變體）對比，未涵蓋 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp。
